messages:
ashleigh: quick report: sample-app works on node, fails on edge build with vite. short repro below.

ashleigh: repro: 1) git clone github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app-sdk -b edge-vite-repro 2) npm ci && npm run build:edge 3) run EDGE=1 npm start (uses local edge-sim)

ashleigh: runtime error: "TypeError: createClient is not a function" coming from server entry where we do `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'` then `Redwood.createClient(...)`.

sam: likely export shape issue. vite/esbuild sometimes produces default-only object so callers expecting top-level named export break.

noah: can you paste the built snippet?

ashleigh: dist/edge/index.js shows `var r = n('redwood-inference'); var client = r.createClient(...)` but r is `{ default: { createClient: f } }`. node CJS masking hides it. edge loader doesn't.

sam: quick workarounds: 1) import named: `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference'` 2) SDK build add cjs interop shim (module.exports.createClient = exports.createClient).

noah: extra gotcha: TS can pick wrong d.ts when conditional exports present. recommend adding explicit types entry and a small tsc smoke test in CI.

ci-bot: CI build #501 failed on edge-vite-repro with same error. logs: https://ci.internal/build/501

ashleigh: action items: ashleigh add minimal `npm run repro:edge` script to sample-app, sam add interop shim PR to SDK, noah add tsc smoke check. will update thread with PR links. :thumbsup:
